captures.what: New bankruptcy filings — debtor, case, chapter, division (RSS feed)
captures.why: Owner bankruptcy is a pre-foreclosure life event
captures.note: The RSS feed is a rolling ~24h window, so this must run daily

captures.why: Permit activity (or its absence) signals investment vs neglect
Demolition filings flag distress and redevelopment

captures.what: County assessor roll — owner, value, sale, legal, location
captures.why: Core property, ownership, and the 3-year value trend
Parcel base; owner mailing vs site address (absentee flag)
Regulated-rental ownership is a landlord/investor signal

captures.what: Active business registry — entity, status, addresses
captures.why: Verify entity owners; a dissolved entity on a home is distress

backfills.what: Per-property code cases and permits for every residential parcel
backfills.why: Code violations are the strongest distress signal and have no bulk source
backfills.note: One-time per-property backfill (~10 days at 200 req / 15 min), not recurring
